children: On September 24, 2026, Nasdaq notified the company that its securities are subject to delisting due to continued non-compliance with the $50 million Market Value of Listed Securities requirement under Listing Rule 5450(b)(2)(A) after the 180-day cure period ended September 23, 2026. The company will request a hearing before the Nasdaq Hearings Panel, which will stay any suspension or delisting action pending the hearing, but there is no assurance of continued listing.
